(2) Subject to petitioner paying 
rupees fifteen thousand to the 
respondents for the use and occupation 
of the shop in question, on or before 7th
of every month w.e.f. November, 2024,
he shall not be dispossessed from the 
said shop. The amount so deposited shall 
be without prejudice to his rights and 
contentions in this writ petition or 
proceedings pending before any other 
forum. However, in case of default in 
payment of the said amount within the 
time stipulated by this Court, petitioner 
shall forth with be liable to be evicted
from the shop in question. 
(3) List on 18.2.2025.
(4) Counter affidavit be filed in the 
meantime. 
(5) Stay application (IA/1/2024) 
stands disposed of accordingly.
